sentences.text: Court has directed that no coercive action action shall be taken against accused persons but that interim order has been vacated by order dated 06.02.2024.
Learned counsel further submits that a direction may be issued to the concerned court to decide the aforesaid case within specific time frame.

4. In view of aforesaid, it is apparent that earlier there was order of this Court that no coercive action shall be taken against accused persons and that interim order has been vacated on 06.09.2024 and thus, it cannot be said that the matter was being delayed by the trial court.
However, considering the entire facts, it is directed that the trial court concerned shall decide the said case, as early as possible, if there is no legal impediment.
5. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of accordingly.
